description: Corrected superposition of the AlphaFold ADNP2 homeodomain onto Antennapedia in the 9ANT protein-DNA complex, with per-position distances to DNA bases and backbone
code:
# =====================================================================
# Corrected version. In the previous cell the 9ANT canonical mapping
# failed (seqA.find(ANTP[:12]) returned -1 because 9ANT chain A starts
# at canonical position 5), so the distance table was shifted by 3.
# Here the mapping is done by alignment and checked explicitly.
# =====================================================================
import requests, numpy as np
from collections import defaultdict
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

H = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"}
AA3 = {"ALA":"A","ARG":"R","ASN":"N","ASP":"D","CYS":"C","GLN":"Q","GLU":"E","GLY":"G","HIS":"H",
       "ILE":"I","LEU":"L","LYS":"K","MET":"M","PHE":"F","PRO":"P","SER":"S","THR":"T","TRP":"W",
       "TYR":"Y","VAL":"V","MSE":"M"}
DNAR = {"DA","DC","DG","DT","DI","DU"}
BBATOMS = {"P","OP1","OP2","OP3","O1P","O2P","O3P","O5'","C5'","C4'","O4'","C3'","O3'","C2'","C1'","O2'"}
ANTP = "RKRGRQTYTRYQTLELEKEFHFNRYLTRRRRIEIAHALCLTERQIKIWFQNRRMKWKKEN"

def parse(txt):
    prot = defaultdict(dict); dbase = []; dback = []
    for ln in txt.split("\n"):
        if not (ln.startswith("ATOM") or ln.startswith("HETATM")): continue
        if ln[16] not in (" ", "A"): continue
        rn = ln[17:20].strip(); ch = ln[21]; an = ln[12:16].strip(); el = ln[76:78].strip()
        if el == "H" or an.startswith("H"): continue
        try: num = int(ln[22:26]); xyz = (float(ln[30:38]), float(ln[38:46]), float(ln[46:54]))
        except ValueError: continue
        if rn in AA3: prot[ch].setdefault(num, [AA3[rn], []])[1].append((an, xyz))
        elif rn in DNAR: (dback if an in BBATOMS else dbase).append(xyz)
    return prot, np.array(dbase), np.array(dback)

ant = requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/9ANT.pdb", timeout=120, headers=H).text
prot, dbase, dback = parse(ant)
chA = prot["A"]; nums = sorted(chA)
seqA = "".join(chA[k][0] for k in nums)
# locate the chain inside the canonical 1-60 reference by exact ungapped search
start = None
for s0 in range(0, 61 - len(seqA) + 1):
    win = ANTP[s0:s0+len(seqA)]
    if len(win) == len(seqA) and sum(a != b for a, b in zip(win, seqA)) <= 2:
        start = s0 + 1; break
print("9ANT chain A, %d residues: %s" % (len(seqA), seqA))
print("canonical start position:", start, " -> covers canonical %d-%d" % (start, start+len(seqA)-1))
ant_map = {start + i: nums[i] for i in range(len(seqA))}
print("check: canonical 48/49/50/51 in 9ANT =",
      "".join(chA[ant_map[p]][0] for p in (48, 49, 50, 51)), "(expect WFQN)")
print("DNA atoms in 9ANT: %d base, %d sugar-phosphate" % (len(dbase), len(dback)))

def fa(a): return "".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/%s.fasta" % a,
                                       timeout=60, headers=H).text.split("\n")[1:])
HD2 = fa("Q6IQ32")[1042:1102]
af = requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q6IQ32", timeout=120, headers=H).json()
afpdb = requests.get(af[0]["pdbUrl"], timeout=180, headers=H).text
afprot, _, _ = parse(afpdb)
afch = list(afprot.values())[0]
a2_map = {p: 1042 + p for p in range(1, 61)}
print("AlphaFold model %s, residues 1043-1102 match UniProt:" % af[0].get("pdbUrl", "").split("/")[-1],
      "".join(afch[a2_map[p]][0] for p in range(1, 61)) == HD2)

def ca(d, n):
    for an, x in d[n][1]:
        if an == "CA": return np.array(x)
CORE = [p for p in range(max(7, start), 58) if p in ant_map]
P = np.array([ca(afch, a2_map[p]) for p in CORE])
Qm = np.array([ca(chA, ant_map[p]) for p in CORE])
pmu, qmu = P.mean(0), Qm.mean(0)
U, Sv, Vt = np.linalg.svd((P - pmu).T @ (Qm - qmu))
R = U @ np.diag([1, 1, np.sign(np.linalg.det(U @ Vt))]) @ Vt
rmsd = np.sqrt((((P - pmu) @ R + qmu - Qm)**2).sum(1).mean())
print("\nKabsch superposition, CA of canonical %d-57: n=%d, RMSD = %.2f A" % (CORE[0], len(P), rmsd))
def xf(x): return (np.array(x) - pmu) @ R + qmu

EMP_BASE  = [5, 47, 50, 51]                      # base contact in >=40% of 35 DNA-bound chains
EMP_BBONE = [6, 8, 25, 44, 48, 53, 55, 57]       # backbone contact in >=60%
def mind(at, ref): return float(np.min(np.linalg.norm(at[:,None,:] - ref[None,:,:], axis=2)))
print("\nminimum heavy-atom distance to DNA in the 9ANT frame (Angstrom)")
print("pos class     Antp  d_base d_bb  |  ADNP2  d_base d_bb")
rows = []
for p in sorted(set(EMP_BASE + EMP_BBONE + [3, 31, 49, 54])):
    if p not in ant_map: continue
    A = np.array([x for _, x in chA[ant_map[p]][1]])
    Bv = np.array([xf(x) for _, x in afch[a2_map[p]][1]])
    cls = "base" if p in EMP_BASE else ("backbone" if p in EMP_BBONE else "other")
    r = (p, cls, chA[ant_map[p]][0], mind(A, dbase), mind(A, dback),
         afch[a2_map[p]][0], mind(Bv, dbase), mind(Bv, dback))
    rows.append(r)
    print("%3d %-9s %s     %5.1f %5.1f  |  %s     %5.1f %5.1f" % r)

# whole-domain view: how many residues of each come within 4 A of DNA
def ncontact(resdict, mp, tf=None):
    nb = nk = 0
    for p in range(1, 61):
        if p not in mp: continue
        at = np.array([x for _, x in resdict[mp[p]][1]])
        if tf is not None: at = np.array([tf(x) for _, x in resdict[mp[p]][1]])
        if mind(at, dbase) <= 4.0: nb += 1
        if mind(at, dback) <= 4.0: nk += 1
    return nb, nk
nb_a, nk_a = ncontact(chA, ant_map)
nb_b, nk_b = ncontact(afch, a2_map, xf)
print("\nresidues within 4 A of DNA, whole 60-mer")
print("  Antennapedia in 9ANT      : %d base-contacting, %d backbone-contacting" % (nb_a, nk_a))
print("  ADNP2 model, rigid-superposed: %d base-contacting, %d backbone-contacting" % (nb_b, nk_b))

# net electrostatic character of the DNA-facing surface
def face_charge(resdict, mp, tf=None, cutoff=8.0):
    pos = neg = 0
    allDNA = np.vstack([dbase, dback])
    for p in range(1, 61):
        if p not in mp: continue
        aa = resdict[mp[p]][0]
        at = np.array([(tf(x) if tf else np.array(x)) for _, x in resdict[mp[p]][1]])
        if mind(at, allDNA) <= cutoff:
            if aa in "KR": pos += 1
            elif aa in "DE": neg += 1
    return pos, neg
print("\nresidues within 8 A of DNA: basic vs acidic")
print("  Antennapedia : %d K/R, %d D/E" % face_charge(chA, ant_map))
print("  ADNP2 model  : %d K/R, %d D/E" % face_charge(afch, a2_map, xf))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 4.4))
x = np.arange(len(rows))
ax.bar(x-0.2, [r[3] for r in rows], 0.4, color="#2a9d8f", label="Antennapedia, 9ANT crystal")
ax.bar(x+0.2, [r[6] for r in rows], 0.4, color="#d1495b", label="ADNP2 AlphaFold model, superposed")
ax.axhline(4.0, color="black", ls="--", lw=1)
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(["%d %s/%s" % (r[0], r[2], r[5]) for r in rows], rotation=90, fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("canonical position, Antennapedia residue / ADNP2 residue")
ax.set_ylabel("min distance to DNA base atoms (A)")
ax.set_title("ADNP2 homeodomain placed on the Antennapedia-DNA complex\nCA RMSD %.2f A over %d residues; dashed line is the 4 A contact cutoff" % (rmsd, len(P)))
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
